game_flow.goal: Farm efficiently, reach Level 4 powerspike, and contest the 1-minute Spirit Crab.
key_actions: Focus on Last Hitting minions for +20% bonus gold.
Contest the 1-minute Spirit Crab in the river to secure early gold and XP lead.
Unlock Ultimate at Level 4 and set up initial ganks with your Jungler.
Track the first Tyrant/Overlord spawn timer at 2 minutes.

game_flow.goal: Destroy outer towers, expand vision control, and secure major objectives.
key_actions: Mid laners and Roamers should actively rotate to side lanes for ganks.
Secure Tyrant (Damage buff) or Overlord (Dragon Vanguard push) with your team.
Invade enemy jungle after outer towers fall to steal buffs and deny economy.

game_flow.goal: Secure Shadow Tyrant/Overlord, breach inhibitor towers, and win 5v5 teamfights.
key_actions: Group up with your team—never get caught solo as death timers are long.
Contest Shadow Tyrant and Shadow Overlord to breach high-ground towers.
Peel and protect your main DPS carries (Marksman/Mage) in teamfights.

game_flow.goal: Secure Tempest Dragon and push for final victory.
key_actions: Clear vision around the Tempest Dragon spawning at 20 minutes.
Use the massive shield and True Damage lightning strikes from Tempest Dragon to end the game.

lanes.title: Farm Lane (Marksman)
lanes.description: Assigned to the right lane. Focuses on safe farming to become the primary physical DPS carry in mid-to-late game teamfights.
tips: Prioritize last hits and constantly check the minimap for enemy jungler rotations.
Farm safely near your tower until you get your core 2-3 damage items.
Position strictly in the backline during teamfights and attack the closest threat.

lanes.title: Mid Lane (Mage)
lanes.description: Assigned to the center lane. Has quick access to both side lanes and controls the tempo of the early-to-mid game.
tips: Clear minion waves quickly with spells and rotate immediately to assist side lanes.
Use river bushes to gain vision and ping enemy rotations for your team.
Initiate or follow up in teamfights with high area-of-effect (AOE) damage and CC.

lanes.title: Clash Lane (Solo Fighter/Tank)
lanes.description: Assigned to the left lane. Requires 1v1 dueling prowess and macro awareness for split-pushing and teamfight initiation.
tips: Win 1v1 trades to gain lane dominance and river control.
Build defensive items to serve as the sturdy frontline tank for your team.
Flank the enemy backline in teamfights to eliminate their squishy Marksman/Mage.

lanes.title: Jungle (Assassin/Fighter)
lanes.description: Clears neutral jungle camps and executes ganks across all lanes to snowball an economic and kill lead.
tips: Start at Blue or Red Buff and optimize your clearing route to hit Level 4 ASAP.
Look for overextended enemies to execute successful ganks and claim First Blood.
Secure Tyrant and Overlord objectives using your Smite spell.

lanes.title: Roam / Support
lanes.description: Roams freely across the map without a fixed lane. Responsible for vision control, peeling carries, and teamfight engagement.
tips: Assist your Mid laner at Level 1 to clear the first wave and contest river vision.
Check bushes safely to provide vision and track enemy jungler movements.
Decide whether to engage with CC or peel enemy assassins off your carries.

objectives.name: Tyrant / Shadow Tyrant
objectives.effects: Grants teamwide gold, XP, and a powerful attack/magic damage buff for teamfighting.
objectives.strategy: Prioritize when preparing for teamfights or looking to win dragon fights.

objectives.name: Overlord / Shadow Overlord
objectives.effects: Spawns powerful Dragon Vanguards in minion waves to push lanes automatically.
objectives.strategy: Best taken when you want to breach enemy towers or apply lane pressure.

objectives.name: Tempest Dragon
objectives.effects: Grants a massive team shield and periodic True Damage lightning strikes to nearby enemies.
objectives.strategy: The ultimate win condition at 20+ minutes. Securing this virtually guarantees victory.

objectives.name: Red & Blue Buffs
objectives.effects: Red Buff: Slows and deals True Damage over time. Blue Buff: +20% CD Reduction & rapid Mana regen.
objectives.strategy: Essential for Junglers early game. Pass to ADC/Mage carries in mid-to-late game.

objectives.name: Spirit Crab
objectives.effects: Neutral river creep that yields significant gold and experience when slain.
objectives.strategy: A crucial early-game contest for lane dominance and gold lead.

mechanics.title: Last Hitting (+20% Gold Bonus)
mechanics.description: Landing the killing blow on minions yields ~20-30% more gold than just standing nearby. Essential for Farm Lane carries.

mechanics.title: Tower Protection Shield (First 4 Minutes)
mechanics.description: During the first 4 minutes, outer turrets take 40% reduced damage. Avoid diving early before this shield expires.

mechanics.title: Counter-Itemization (Anti-Heal & Armor)
mechanics.description: Build Grievous Wounds (Venomous Staff / Mortal Punisher) against high-heal heroes. Buy Ominous Premonition against physical burst.

mechanics.title: Vision Control & Bush Checking
mechanics.description: Bushes hide enemies. Always use long-range skillshots to check bushes before entering to avoid getting ambushed.

settings.reason: Set to Lowest Absolute HP so assassins and marksmen automatically target low-health squishy carries.
Use Manual Aim (Finger Drag) instead of auto-aim to reliably land skillshots on moving targets.
Enable thumb-swipe camera panning to inspect teamfights and enemy health outside your main screen view.
Enlarge the minimap to track enemy jungler movements and lane pushes at a glance.

glossary.definition: The total number of enemy minions and jungle monsters slain by a player, essential for computing last hits and farming efficiency.
An ambush maneuver where junglers or roamers surprise an enemy lane to create a numerical advantage and secure kills.
Leaving one's assigned lane to travel across the map and assist teammates in other lanes or invade the enemy jungle.
Abilities that restrict or impede enemy movement and actions, including Stuns, Knockups, Silences, Taunts, and Slows.
Attacking while moving backward or sideways to maintain a safe distance from enemy melee threats, heavily used by Marksmen.
Entering the enemy's jungle territory to steal neutral camps (especially Red/Blue buffs) or kill the enemy jungler.
Holding the minion clash point right outside your turret range to farm safely while denying the enemy farm and experience.
Using crowd control or defensive abilities to keep enemy assassins and divers away from your vulnerable Marksman/Mage carries.
Aggressively pursuing and killing an enemy hero under their own turret while taking turret damage.
How much a hero increases in power as the game progresses with levels and core item purchases.
Leveraging small early advantages (kills, last hits) into exponentially larger leads to swiftly close out the game.
A hero's ability to regenerate health and mana over time to remain active on the map without constantly recalling.
Using long-range abilities to deal damage and wear down enemy health bars safely before initiating a teamfight.
Dealing a massive amount of damage in a fraction of a second, typically executed by Assassins and Mages.
Intentionally initiating a teamfight using hard CC or initiation spells, typically performed by Tank frontliners.
Using mobility, shields, or CC to escape an unfavorable teamfight or reset the engagement.
High-durability heroes (Tanks/Fighters) who stand at the front to absorb enemy damage and protect their backline.
Fragile high-damage carries (Marksmen/Mages) who position safely behind frontliners to output sustained DPS.
Approaching a teamfight from the side or behind to bypass the enemy tank frontline and assassinate squishy carries.
Adopting a defensive playstyle by remaining safely under turrets or inside the base when playing from behind.
The final inner turret protecting the base crystal. Destroying it spawns powerful Super Minions in that lane.
Helping your jungler clear their first jungle buff faster by dealing a few initial hits without stealing XP or gold.
Overall high-level strategic awareness, including map control, objective timing, split-pushing, and lane rotations.
Individual mechanical skill, including skillshot accuracy, reaction time, dodging, and animation canceling.
The Most Effective Tactic Available—the current optimal strategies, hero picks, and builds in the current game patch.
